name: darktable
title: darktable: free Lightroom alternative
hook: Lightroom charges you twelve bucks a month to edit your raw photos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Fix light, color and detail with sliders and curves. Your originals stay untouched.
Browse, rate and tag thousands of photos in one library.
It opens raw files from most cameras, and exports to JPEG, PNG or TIFF.

caption:
Lightroom charges $11.99/month to edit your raw photos. darktable does it for free 📸

✅ Develop raw photos with sliders, curves and color tools
✅ Non-destructive: your original files are never modified
✅ Browse, rate and tag your whole photo library
✅ Opens raw files from most cameras, exports JPEG, PNG or TIFF
✅ No subscription, no cloud account, no ads

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Heads up: it's not a Lightroom clone, it works its own way and takes longer to learn, and the Mac download is for Apple Silicon (M1 and newer)
